title: Animations
description: How windows, workspaces and shell panels move, and the motion inside the shell.

sections.title: What each part controls
sections.description: Hyprland animates windows, workspaces and shell panels; the shell animates its own menus and controls.

sections.title: General
sections.description: Turn every desktop animation on or off at once.

sections.title: Windows
sections.description: How windows open, close and move, and whether resizing and dragging are animated.

sections.title: Workspaces
sections.description: How you move between workspaces and how the auxiliary workspace (Super+S) appears.

sections.title: Shell panels
sections.description: How long shell panels such as the sidebars take to open and close, and with which curve.

sections.title: Details
sections.description: The color change of the active window border and the screen zoom (Super + = / Super + -).

sections.title: My curves
sections.description: Curves you create here, ready to use in any animation on this page.

sections.title: Motion inside the shell
sections.description: Speed of the menus, buttons and panels drawn by the shell; it does not change Hyprland animations.

entries.label: Game Mode is on
entries.description: Game Mode turns off desktop animations while it is on; your changes are saved and apply when you turn it off.

entries.label: Desktop animations
entries.description: Animate windows, workspaces and shell panels; motion inside the shell has its own setting below.

entries.label: Animate manual resizing
entries.description: When you resize a window yourself, the change is animated instead of instant.

entries.label: Animate windows dragged with the mouse
entries.description: A window you drag follows the pointer with an animation instead of sticking to it.
entries.help: Some curves make the dragged window wobble or lag behind; turn this off if dragging feels unsteady.

entries.label: Wraparound workspace slide
entries.description: Moving between the last and the first workspace slides as if they were next to each other.

entries.label: Gap between workspaces while sliding
entries.description: Empty space between two workspaces during the slide animation, in pixels.
entries.help: It adds to the gap at the screen edges.

entries.label: Speed of menus and transitions
entries.description: How fast the menus, buttons and transitions drawn by the shell move.
entries.help: It does not change how Hyprland opens windows or shell panels; that is the rest of this page. Loading spinners keep their speed.

options.label: Very fast
options.description: Transitions take half the usual time.

options.label: Fast
options.description: Transitions take three quarters of the usual time.

options.label: Normal
options.description: The speed the shell was designed with.

options.label: Slow
options.description: Transitions take one and a half times as long.

options.label: Very slow
options.description: Transitions take twice as long, so it is easier to follow what moves.

entries.label: Reduce motion in the shell
entries.description: Transitions inside the shell end instantly instead of animating.
entries.help: While it is on, the speed above has no effect and loading spinners keep turning. For the desktop itself, use the Minimal preset at the top of this page.
